shimmer.config.title: Shimmer Settings
shimmer.config.exposure.tooltip: Manual exposure, −20 to +20 EV. +1 doubles brightness; −1 halves it.
shimmer.config.overlay.tooltip: Keep vanilla's panorama overlay. Menu blur is controlled by Minecraft's settings.
shimmer.config.colorSpace.tooltip: Color space for HDR files without PRIMARIES. Tagged files use their own primaries.
shimmer.config.applyHint: Save applies changes with a resource reload.
shimmer.config.invalidExposure: Enter a finite exposure between −20 and +20 EV.
shimmer.config.saveError: Could not save settings. See the game log.
